title: Unison AST + Swift runtime + cross-platform layout + market-event observatory
origin: Owner current turn: reverse trees of Swift/iOS, Android/Kotlin and HTML/JS, Unibet codebook, time-bearing IO, Swift-served web frontend, open source market strategy engine language, market event concentration.

prerequisites.technology: Swift 6.2.1 installed locally; official Swift Android/Wasm SDK sources

constraints: Publish independent, additive files to GLASS/main; do not rewrite concurrent work
No assumption that iOS SwiftUI/UIKit binary can execute on Android; use Swift shared portable core and explicit UI adapters
Swift server on Linux, WebAssembly Swift optional (no invented browser support), Swift Android cross-compilation requires SDK/NDK
No unbounded self-modifying background agent; bounded on-demand and opt-in watch loop with journaling
Do not infer functional SDK behavior solely from AST; no magic irreversible SHA decompression
Do not claim access to private stock exchange click streams; all first-stage market data synthetic, provider input scoped and credentialed
Do not claim novelty or performance gains from a deterministic source-code size test
No external scientific-theory validation; public technology documentation used only to verify OSS capabilities
Keep external source code and licenses separate; do not vendor uninspected apps
recovery: Write source/trace receipts, preserve outstanding failures. On remote concurrency re-read head before publication; never force update.
output_gates: ASTs via genuine language parsers for Swift/TypeScript/Python/HTML
typed finite Unison IR with codebook roundtrip
market event anomaly window scored on bounded simulation
host tests and exact GitHub readback

security.server: localhost by default, GET-only read-only API
security.deployment: no credentials, trading or execution rights
